Question: What is the average loss of each policy by policy number where loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amounts?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    AVG(policy_loss.Total_Loss) AS Average_Loss
FROM (
    SELECT
        cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        cc.Effective_Date,
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)) AS Total_Loss
    FROM Claim c
    INNER JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
        ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
    INNER JOIN Claim_Amount ca
        ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Loss_Payment lp
        WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Loss_Reserve lr
        WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Expense_Payment ep
        WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Expense_Reserve er
        WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    GROUP BY
        cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        cc.Effective_Date,
        c.Claim_Identifier
) policy_loss
INNER JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON policy_loss.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND policy_loss.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
INNER JOIN Policy p
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number;

What is the premium amount of all policies by policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number;

What is the premium amount of all policies by policy number, coverage effective date and coverage expiration date
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    pcd.Effective_Date AS Coverage_Effective_Date,
    pcd.Expiration_Date AS Coverage_Expiration_Date,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
FROM Premium pr
INNER JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
INNER JOIN Policy p
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
INNER JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND pa.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    pcd.Effective_Date,
    pcd.Expiration_Date
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    pcd.Effective_Date,
    pcd.Expiration_Date;
